description: Ask for a brand, usually a competitor, to be added to the Sequenzy email gallery so its real emails can be used as references. Pass its website or domain. Asking again for the same domain keeps the one request (a new note replaces the old) and returns created false. If the brand is already in the gallery, the request comes back with status available. A company can keep up to 50 requests. It is not your own website. Requires templates:write.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

note.description: Optional, up to 300 characters: what you want to see from them, such as their onboarding emails.

website.description: The brand's website or domain, such as competitor.com or https://competitor.com/pricing.

name: request_gallery_brand

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `request_gallery_brand` MCP tool.

created.description: False when the company had already requested this domain.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

request.description: The request: id, domain, note, status, declineReason, requestedAt and brand.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
